inputs.text: The warning makes it clear that the APC’s direction ahead of the 2027 elections is no accident. The wealthy are being positioned to keep influence while ordinary people are pushed out, and the language of “accident” helps conceal who benefits. Democracy may remain on paper, but the real decisions about whose voice matters are being shaped behind the scenes.
